actions.action: Remove the humidity dome once seeds sprout
Place seedlings under a grow light 2-3 inches above them, on 14-16 hours per day
Turn off or remove the heat mat to keep seedlings at about 60-70°F
Bottom water: fill the tray, let it soak 10-15 minutes, dump the excess, and rewater only when the top of the soil is dry
Set up a small oscillating fan for a gentle breeze
Thin crowded cells by snipping the extra seedlings
Alternatively, wash the soil off the roots and separate seedlings by their leaves into their own cells
Fertilize weekly with half-strength liquid fertilizer such as Neptune's Harvest once true leaves appear

verdict.reason: This is a generic seedling-care transcript that never says the lychee seed is viable or that it should be planted, so it neither gives the diagnosis nor the fix, though its advice is unlikely to harm the plant.
